name: Larvae
languages: The languages it knew in life
notes: CR 5. Wears faces from target's past. Threshold Reset. Cycling Faces.
gm_notes: Roman hungry ghost -- wears faces of the target's past (loved ones, dead comrades, enemies). Threshold Reset at less than 20 HP: passes through solid surface and resets to full HP (can do this once per encounter). Cycling Faces below half HP: face changes every round, cycling through target's memories. Does not flee. See bestiary.qmd for full mechanics.
